description:
Changes

* Clearly label the UI preview, remove its app-drawer entry and prevent its setup report from claiming active Messenger controls. Real patched Messenger still gets its embedded settings launcher.
* Add Copy setup with app versions and known control states. It excludes account and chat data.
* Preserve page, category and search state across language changes. Keep multi-digit numbers readable in the RTL test language, including Arabic numeric separators.
* Generate the catalog from the built bundle, retain distinct hidden dependency identities and reject release metadata or checksum drift.

Verification

All 133 local tests pass. Both exact supported Messenger APKs apply all 21 patches, and all 57 expected host hook calls are present. Rebuilds preserve every original class and all 13 native libraries. APK v3 signatures verify. Two clean bundle builds produce the same SHA-256. Lint has no errors and seven existing warnings.

Issue #1 still needs its exact original APK, build 346013370. Live ad removal, typing suppression and the other host behaviors remain unverified in a working original-package installation.

The .mpp file is a patch bundle for Morphe, not an installable Messenger APK. Exact supported arm64 builds are 346013387 and 346013440. Verify the download with SHA256SUMS.txt.
